description: This file contains unit tests for group and team management commands in the Mattermost CLI, including LDAP group listing, team group enabling/disabling, channel group listing, and user group restoration.

methods.name: TestListLdapGroupsCmd
methods.description: Unit test for listing LDAP groups, testing both failure and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupEnableCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for enabling team group constraints, covering various error and success cases.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupDisableCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for disabling team group constraints, covering various error and success cases.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupListCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for listing channel groups for a team and channel, including error handling and different group counts.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupListCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for listing groups associated with a team, including error handling and output verification.

methods.name: TestTeamGroupStatusCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for checking group constraint status of a team, including not present, enabled, and disabled states.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupStatusCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for checking group constraint status of a channel, including various error scenarios and states.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupEnableCmdF
methods.description: Unit tests for enabling group constraints on a channel, covering multiple error and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestChannelGroupDisableCmdF
methods.description: Unit tests for disabling group constraints on a channel, covering multiple error and success scenarios.

methods.name: TestUserGroupRestoreCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for restoring a deleted user group, handling both success and not found errors.
